purpose: FINAL PASS optional thin-skill residual fill after wave5: Construction workbench/Fort high-tier/D&D alternatives, Runecrafting necrotic+attuner+pouch/Ourania residuals, Agility mid/high residual courses not fully expanded beyond wave5 course names, Hunter residuals not in wave5 (grenwalls, Anachronia BGH/jadinkos, birdhouses, butterflies, Big Chinchompa, Iaia lodge), and Summoning residual pouch-rate/obelisk/Havenhythe shrine methods. Wiki-published rates only; ironman/Equilibrium region notes; no invented XP/h.

methods.method: Furniture workbench mahogany round tables (flatpack AFK)
methods.level_range: 68+ (mahogany round table row); mahogany ladder from 50+ chair/bench
methods.location: POH furniture workbench, portable workbench (main-game w84), or house portal bank loop
methods.xp_rate: wiki Construction training furniture workbench Experience rates and profit table: mahogany round table 840 XP/item → 604,800 XP/h (table assumes ~720 furniture/h stated in Method overview). Lower mahogany rows: chair 201,600 XP/h; bench 403,200 XP/h. Teak long table alternative 518,400 XP/h at −3.36 gp/XP framing vs mahogany −10.28 gp/XP
methods.notes: Complements Construction Contracts (wave5) when banked planks exist. Ironman: sawmill/plank maker + Miscellania hardwoods; portable workbench +10% XP / 7.5% plank save is main-game convenience. Page banner: may be outdated after 2026 Construction update.
methods.warning: Construction training page carries a 2026 Construction update out-of-date banner.

methods.method: Furniture workbench teak long tables (cost-efficient flatpacks)
methods.level_range: 56+ teak long table; teak ladder 36–68 before mahogany prioritisation
methods.location: POH / portable furniture workbench near bank
methods.xp_rate: wiki workbench table: teak long table 720 XP/item → 518,400 XP/h; teak round table 388,800 XP/h; teak bench 259,200 XP/h; teak chair 129,600 XP/h (same ~720 items/h assumption)
methods.notes: Wiki notes teak long tables cheaper than mahogany tables through 99 on plank cost framing. Ironman default when mahogany stock is thin. Pairs with contracts for active XP and workbench for AFK plank burns.

methods.method: Fort Forinthry high-tier building / reinforce (Perfect Build active)
methods.level_range: 75 Workshop T3 through 99 Command Centre T3; 105 eternal reinforcement T3 on table
methods.location: Fort Forinthry buildings + blueprints table (New Foundations unlock)
methods.xp_rate: wiki Fort buildings table Active XP/hour (100% Perfect Build, excludes Workshop 5/10/15% building XP boost): Workshop T3 644,616; Ranger's Workroom T3 / Townhall T3 890,880; Kitchen T3 889,102; Chapel T3 1,235,245; Botanist's Workbench T3 1,234,765; Guardhouse T3 1,236,480; Command Centre T3 1,235,965; Eternal reinforcement T3 1,999,800. Baseline (0% Perfect Build) column is much lower (e.g. Chapel T3 552,000 XP/h)
methods.intensity: long AFK builds; optional active optimal-hotspot Perfect Build upkeep
methods.notes: Working Fort taxonomy is Misthalin despite SE Wilderness geography. Reinforce reuses tier materials for pure XP. Example AFK stretch: 840-progress project 18–25 minutes. Complements contracts/workbench; process limestone/planks in Fort workshop first.

methods.level_range: after Let Them Eat Pie; tutorial mode off
methods.location: Copernicus Glyph statue sites (Canifis, Gu'Tanoth, Falador, Prifddinas, Taverley)
methods.xp_rate: wiki: each completed statue awards Construction experience equal to a large XP lamp (level-scaled); monthly D&D — not a continuous XP/h grind. Outfit/chisel/bonus XP do not affect the Construction lamp reward
methods.notes: Also grants Slayer or Prayer XP depending on statue choice. Multi-city sites — pick cities in unlocked League regions. Residual alternative method, not a primary training spine.

methods.level_range: tier 1: 50+ in four primary skills; tier 2: 70+ primary+secondary; tier 3: 90+ primary+secondary
methods.location: Shifting Tombs, Menaphos (after The Jack of Spades)
methods.xp_rate: wiki: primary skill choices include Construction (with Dungeoneering/Agility/Thieving); secondary XP in Crafting/Runecrafting/Prayer/Divination or loot mode. 5-minute runs — no frozen Construction-only XP/h published on the Construction training page
methods.intensity: active timed minigame (solo or ironman-only groups)
methods.notes: Desert/Menaphos dependency. Useful when multi-skill XP is acceptable; default loot mode must be switched to experience pledges. Do not invent hourly Construction rates from run timers.

methods.level_range: 1 spirit; 20 bone; 40 flesh; 60 miasma (impure essence / City of Um path)
methods.location: City of Um necromantic altars (Rune Mythos progression)
methods.xp_rate: wiki Pay-to-play Runecrafting training necrotic table (assumes 220 trips/h and 126 essence/trip): spirit 304,920 XP/h; bone 415,800 XP/h; flesh 482,328 XP/h; miasma 554,400 XP/h
methods.notes: Residual XP numbers for necromantic path already named without rates in earlier gap files. Ironman impure essence from rituals is the gate. Page still incomplete for 110 RC / Savvy Runecrafting — treat as pre-Savvy baseline.
methods.warning: Training page incomplete after 110 Runecrafting / Savvy unlocks; re-benchmark high rates.

methods.level_range: high RC with soul altar access; wiki worked example at 105+
methods.location: Abyss altar runs for first 49 attunements → fully charged soul altar for 50th (Desert soul altar geography; Abyss entrance is Forinthry pressure)
methods.xp_rate: wiki: 50th attunement on fully charged soul altar at 105 grants minimum 550,000 XP plus XP from the first 49 trips. Theoretical perfect movement ~2 cycles/h → well in excess of 1,500,000 XP/h with Abyssal titan + Infinity ethereal; more realistic ~32 minutes per 50 attunements → around 1,000,000 XP/h
methods.intensity: very high intensity movement + charge timing
methods.notes: Late-game ceiling method. Ironman: pure essence bank + expansive/pouches + soul charge logistics. Complements wave5 soul charged crafts and eternal imbuing rather than replacing Runespan mid-game.

methods.method: Crafting sealed / grasping rune pouches (magical thread)
methods.level_range: 50 sealed small; 90 sealed large / grasping path on wiki table
methods.location: Bank-standing rune pouch craft (thread + pouch ingredients)
methods.xp_rate: wiki Creating rune pouches table at 90% efficiency: sealed small rune pouch 2,700,000 XP/h (1,800 crafts/h); sealed large 18,000,000 XP/h row on table; grasping rune pouch 13,500,000 XP/h (1,350/h) or 5,400,000 XP/h from-scratch path (540/h). Extremely expensive; magical thread buy limit 1,000 is the real throttle
methods.notes: Residual high-ceiling bank method. Ironman/League: thread/flakes supply is the gate — treat as burst when stockpiled, not default spine. Complements Abyss/Runespan for normal progression.

methods.level_range: usable mid/high; wiki cites level 82 measurement
methods.location: Ourania Cave altar west of Battlefield / south of West Ardougne (Ourania Teleport return)
methods.xp_rate: wiki: players can gain upwards of 66,000 XP/h at level 82 with Mobile + Wise and teleport banking (wiki flags [source needed] and incomplete banner for 99 rates)
methods.notes: Kandarin geography. Alternative when Abyss/Forinthry is locked. Do not promote above Runespan/necrotic high rates without re-benchmark.
methods.warning: Ourania section incomplete; 99 XP rates missing; 66k figure tagged source needed.

methods.level_range: 52-80 primary band on wiki summary
methods.location: Wilderness Agility Course
methods.xp_rate: wiki Agility training summary: 51,390 XP/h (52-60 band row; course used through 80 before Hefin/Anachronia island-wide)
methods.intensity: active course with failure damage; food recommended
methods.notes: Hard Forinthry. Wilderness sword 2+ adds 5% lap XP. Residual mid ladder between Anachronia novice and high courses already in wave5. Keep health low for failure damage formula.
methods.warning: Agility training page may be out of date after 2026 mid-game rebalance XP rework.

methods.level_range: 65-77 alternative / summary 65-70 primary
methods.location: Het's Oasis Agility Course
methods.xp_rate: wiki summary: 70,114 XP/h
methods.notes: Desert continuous Agility when Tirannwn/Anachronia locked. Synergizes with Oasis whirligig Hunter and bush Farming. Re-benchmark after mid-game rebalance banner.

methods.level_range: 60-65 summary band
methods.location: Bandos's Throne Room (God Wars / Bandos throne course)
methods.xp_rate: wiki summary: 60,171 XP/h; Werewolf Agility Course alternative ~60,000 XP/h in same band
methods.notes: Asgarnia residual mid course. Requires God Wars access path. Catalog already has wilderness/het/anachronia high ends — this fills the 60-65 gap band.

methods.level_range: 70-77 summary band before Hefin / full island-wide
methods.location: Anachronia advanced course section
methods.xp_rate: wiki summary: 78,000 XP/h; Het's Oasis alternative 70,114 XP/h in the same band
methods.notes: Residual step before wave5 island-wide Anachronia (210k/220k). Base-camp spa tiers and powerful roar +25% still apply on Anachronia obstacles.

methods.location: Empty Throne Room, Varrock Dig Site
methods.xp_rate: wiki: fully AFK Manual Auto-cycles with a hard cap of 800,000 Agility XP from the activity; body states rates are very low vs Het's Oasis course at 65. Empowered purple-glow cycles swap every 42s for better efficiency — no separate frozen XP/h row on the training summary
methods.notes: Starting-region AFK sink with lifetime XP cap. Prefer courses when attention is available. Progress checked via Celia Diggory outside the throne room.

methods.level_range: 77-99/110 alternative band
methods.location: Anachronia grenwall area NE of lodestone (preferred); Elf Camp; or Prif Gorajo resource dungeon (95 Dungeoneering)
methods.xp_rate: wiki: Anachronia location with Crystallise and no other boosts ~70,000-180,000 XP/h from 77-99; with level/catch boosts base rates can almost double and combined boosts can easily exceed 500,000 XP/h
methods.intensity: semi-AFK box traps + Crystallise/Light Form upkeep
methods.notes: Not in wave5 whirligig/BGH set. Needs Regicide + Crystallise (The Light Within) + Light Form; medium Tirannwn diary for baitless traps. Leave one uncrystallised trap + bonecrusher necklace for prayer sustain. Private grenwall area uses Big Chinchompa quota tickets.

methods.level_range: 75 Hunter + 55 Slayer entry; scales through higher dinosaur tiers to 110
methods.location: Anachronia Big Game Hunter arenas (nine dinosaur species)
methods.xp_rate: wiki: each kill ~2-5 minutes; multi-dino encounters raise XP; page does not freeze a single continuous XP/h for Anachronia BGH in the same way Havenhythe summary quotes 420,000-2,464,500 — treat as encounter method with per-kill XP from the dinosaur table, not an invented hourly
methods.notes: Residual vs wave5 Havenhythe BGH. Most profitable Hunter method framing + dragon mattock / terrasaur pieces. Dinosaurs cooldown after ≥5 kills (~1h). Ironman: Anachronia unlock + baits + Slayer levels.

methods.level_range: 80+; carrion 88+ for top protean band
methods.location: Anachronia jadinko habitats (prefer over Herblore Habitat when level allows)
methods.xp_rate: wiki: ~300 catches/h at minimum level → ~600/h at 99 with Combined Catalyst fragment + Hunter cape trap reset. Base without further boosts/urns: 60,000-120,000 XP/h (common jadinkos) to 190,000-380,000 XP/h (carrion). Protean traps on carrion: 900,000-1,000,000 XP/h with no drops
methods.notes: Zamorak's favour +10% jadinko XP. Some types need juju hunter potion on vine blossoms. Residual high Anachronia path between whirligigs and Havenhythe BGH.

methods.level_range: 5-110 continuous birdhouse ladder
methods.location: 8 Havenhythe birdhouse spots per lap
methods.xp_rate: wiki: ~2,880 XP/h at level 5 scaling up to around 200,000 XP/h at level 101; ~3 minutes per 8-house lap when run actively
methods.notes: Not in wave5. Also gathers raw bird meat supply. Ironman: Havenhythe region unlock + birdhouse tiers. Pair with other Havenhythe skilling loops.

methods.level_range: 80-88 Hunter band; Agility 75 up to 90 by butterfly tier
methods.location: Butterfly habitats requiring matching Agility tier
methods.xp_rate: wiki: 72,000-120,000 Hunter XP/h plus 12,000-32,000 Agility XP/h; butterflies last ~5s to 5+ minutes before despawn
methods.notes: Residual AFK Hunter not covered by wave5 whirligigs/moths. Tellervo's net improves catch chance. Prefer charming moths/spirit moths when available for higher combined rates.

methods.level_range: scales with Hunter; wiki rate cited at 99
methods.location: Hourly Big Chinchompa cavern (Nyriki's portal, Tree Gnome Stronghold, 3 uses/day)
methods.xp_rate: wiki: up to 209,500 experience an hour at level 99 Hunter; max 2 participations per day; max 1,500 competence points per entry
methods.notes: Competence points buy grenwall quota tickets for private grenwall area. Protea flowers help moth catches. Residual recurring method.

methods.method: Dream of Iaia hunting lodge (stored Hunter XP withdraw)
methods.level_range: after Extinction + building the hunting lodge station
methods.location: Dream of Iaia hunting lodge
methods.xp_rate: wiki: station stores up to 350,000 Hunter XP; withdrawing stored XP is 350,000 experience per hour while skilling at the station (build awards 135,000 stored + 15,000 direct XP for 50,000 of each base-camp resource)
methods.notes: Parallel to Construction Iaia stonemason (wave5). Restock: 2 vines → 1 XP stored. Ironman base-camp vine supply is the gate.

methods.method: Spirit kyatt / Piscatoris high-speed pouch infusion
methods.level_range: 57+ for spirit kyatt tele method; any pouch tier once charms/tertiaries banked
methods.location: Piscatoris Summoning obelisk + War's Retreat / TokKul-Zo / Deep Sea hub bank teleports
methods.xp_rate: wiki Summoning training: over 2,700 pouches per hour with spirit kyatt tele + bank tele loop (one of the fastest pouch methods). Convert to XP/h via pouch XP of the charm tier being infused — do not invent a single frozen XP/h without specifying pouch type
methods.notes: Residual logistics rate missing from prior pouch-ladder summaries. Below 57 use Phoenix Lair tele + run. Nature Grotto fairy-ring alternative is slower but kyatt-free. Ironman: charm + tertiary stockpile is the real gate.

methods.method: Amlodd obelisk pouch crafting during Voice of Seren
methods.level_range: after Plague's End; best with attuned crystal teleport seed (85 Smithing)
methods.location: Prifddinas Amlodd Summoning obelisk; bank Ithell/Trahaearn
methods.xp_rate: wiki: Voice of Seren on Amlodd grants 20% extra base pouch/scroll XP (120% base) and improves shard returns with Lord Amlodd (77% with hard Tirannwn achievements vs 70% default). Portable fairy ring DJS called fastest obelisk access. Pouch/hour depends on tele setup (see kyatt 2,700+/h class methods)
methods.intensity: bank tele + short run; medium-high when optimised
methods.notes: Hard Tirannwn. Shard recycle loop is the ironman cost mitigator. Catalog already names Amlodd obelisk — this residual row locks VoS + 20% base XP + shard % facts for optimizer notes.

methods.method: Shrine of Inanna pouch crafting (Havenhythe Spirit Plane Connection)
methods.level_range: any pouch tier; outfit grind 3,600 pouches for full Shaman's set
methods.location: Shrine of Inanna obelisks near Wendlewick (fairy ring BKS); bank west after Trader Woes
methods.xp_rate: wiki: slower/more active than Prif/Piscatoris tele methods; stacking Spirit Plane Connection buff improves save chance and XP per pouch. Spirit Wolf offering (100 shards) → Spirit Communion: next 100 pouches keep Connection from decaying and −0.6s pouch create time. No single frozen XP/h published on the main training page
methods.notes: 1 Blessing of the Wolf per pouch → Shaman's outfit shop (Havenhythe). Residual vs wave/misc shaman outfit purchase row — this is the XP/training site that generates the currency. Prefer Amlodd/kyatt when raw pouch rate matters.

methods.method: Charm-tier pouch XP bands (gold/green stop guidance)
methods.level_range: gold charm pouches mid-game; green into 80s before prioritising crimson/blue
methods.location: Any high-rate obelisk (Taverley / Menaphos Merchant / Amlodd / Piscatoris)
methods.xp_rate: wiki Summoning training guidance: gold-charm pouching around level 66 yields ~230,000-240,000 XP/h (page frames this as expensive for XP gained / often not worth continuing gold); green charms around level 80 yield ~370,000-420,000 XP/h under the same cost-efficiency warning framing
methods.notes: Residual numeric bands for charm tiers after pouch-ladder summaries that lacked XP/h. Ironman should still burn charms into useful familiars (terrorbird, yak, unicorn, etc.) even when gp/XP framing says stop — League value is familiar utility + XP.
